title: 2025 SAGE RC Autograph Connor O'Toole Utah Utes Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 SAGE Rookie Autograph trading card featuring Connor O'Toole from the Utah Utes football team in the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). The card is not autographed and is manufactured by SAGE. It is part of the 2025 SAGE set.
